categories.main_business_segments: Robert Half International Inc. operates through three main business segments: Contract Talent Solutions (providing contract professionals in finance and accounting, technology, marketing and creative, legal, and administrative/customer support), Permanent Placement Talent Solutions (full-time placement in similar fields), and Protiviti (a global consulting subsidiary focused on internal audit, risk, business, and technology consulting).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital platforms, a global candidate database, and artificial intelligence-driven technologies for talent matching and recruitment. Protiviti utilizes proprietary methodologies and tools for consulting, risk management, and digital transformation, while Robert Half’s talent solutions rely on standardized operating procedures, centralized support, and managed services for client engagements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Robert Half serves a broad range of clients, including businesses of all sizes across industries such as finance, technology, legal, marketing, and administration. Protiviti’s clients include high-growth startups, large global corporations, and government entities seeking consulting and internal audit services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia, with 317 talent solutions offices in 42 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, and 18 foreign countries, and 65 Protiviti offices in 23 U.S. states and 13 foreign countries. No single country outside the U.S. accounts for more than 10% of revenues.
categories.supply_chain_position: Robert Half operates as a downstream service provider, directly interfacing with end customers by supplying specialized talent and consulting services. The company acts as the employer of record for contract professionals and delivers value-added consulting through Protiviti.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding digital capabilities, leveraging AI and data analytics for recruitment, enhancing the digital and recruiter experience, and investing in technology infrastructure. The company is focused on innovation in talent solutions, flexible work models, and expanding consulting offerings through Protiviti, with ongoing investments in employee development and diversity initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through hourly billings for contract talent, placement fees for permanent hires (typically a percentage of the candidate’s annual compensation), and consulting fees (time-and-materials or fixed-fee) for Protiviti’s services. The company recognizes revenue as services are delivered and does not rely on long-term contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In talent solutions, Robert Half competes with national, regional, and local staffing firms, with local firms often being the strongest competitors. In consulting, Protiviti’s main competitors are the Big Four accounting firms and other consultancies. Robert Half differentiates itself through its global brand, office network, candidate database, and advanced technology, while Protiviti emphasizes a collaborative, configure-to-fit approach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Robert Half achieved record service revenues of $7.24 billion (up 12% year-over-year) and net income of $658 million (up 9.9%). U.S. operations accounted for 78.9% of revenue, with international operations at 21.1%. All major segments reached all-time high revenues, reflecting strong growth across contract, permanent placement, and consulting services.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Robert Half emphasizes its ability to deliver highly skilled, specialized talent quickly and efficiently, supported by a global brand, extensive office network, and advanced AI-driven recruitment technologies. Protiviti’s value proposition centers on deep expertise, a collaborative consulting approach, and the ability to blend consulting professionals with specialized talent for tailored client solutions.
